name: Barnett Residence

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a long paved driveway that leads to a looping area in front of the residence, allowing for turnaround. Mature pine trees surround much of the property and may limit visibility and sightlines in some areas. Open terrain and landscaped areas around the house provide reasonable space for emergency vehicle staging. The property is located in a semi-rural residential neighborhood with spaced homes and road access.
